edbDesc: The physical process responsible for the attractive interactions between atoms and molecules, and which confers stability to diatomic and polyatomic chemical compounds. In general, chemical bonding is associated with the sharing of electrons between the participating atoms. Molecules, crystals, and diatomic gases and most of the physical environment around us are held together by chemical bonds.
title: Chemical Bonding
